items.headline: Clemson's QB rotation of Pearman and Denson, defense help the Tigers beat Duke 20-10
items.description: — Trent Pearman and Chris Denson each ran for touchdowns while rotating at quarterback for injury-hit Clemson, helping the Tigers beat Duke 20-10 on Friday night to close their Atlantic Coast Conference schedule.
